research_question: How did the annual discharge of the Middle Fork and South Fork of the Boise River during water years 2012–2014 compare to their long-term median discharge?

phase_1.user_prompt: I'm looking into historical flow conditions in the Arrowrock Reservoir tributaries in Idaho to understand potential fish habitat variability. I need to find the specific USGS streamgages for the 'Boise River near Twin Springs' and the 'South Fork Boise River at Anderson Ranch Dam'. Can you find the official USGS site numbers for these two locations and identify the standard parameter code for daily volumetric flow?

phase_2.user_prompt: Great. Now please retrieve the daily discharge data for both of these sites for their entire period of record up through the end of water year 2014 (September 30, 2014).

phase_3.user_prompt: To establish our recent baseline, please process the daily discharge data to calculate the average annual discharge for the 2012 water year (October 1, 2011 to September 30, 2012) for the Twin Springs site. Since the raw data is in cubic feet per second, convert your final answer to cubic meters per second. What is the calculated average annual discharge for this water year?

phase_4.user_prompt: Now, I want to understand how the 2012-2014 water years compare to their historical baselines. First, calculate the average annual discharge for water year 2012 at the South Fork site (at Anderson Ranch Dam) in cubic meters per second. Then, calculate the long-term median of the annual average discharges for both sites over their entire historical record up to 2014. Finally, write a brief interpretation comparing the annual discharge of water years 2012, 2013, and 2014 to their respective long-term medians. Which years were consistently above or below the median for both tributaries?

checkpoint.reference_conclusion: Annual discharge for both the Middle Fork and South Fork of the Boise River was greater than the long-term median in water year 2012, and less than the long-term median in water year 2013. In water year 2014, the discharge at the Middle Fork was above its long-term median, while the South Fork discharge was below its median.
